sourceIssues.description: The phrase “No external force acting” is immediately followed by gravity inclusion. Interpret it as no externally applied terminal wrench, not absence of gravitational body forces. The +g Y0 base seed is a gravity bookkeeping device, not actual base acceleration.
The text attributes p12=pC1 to a point mass. More precisely this equality needs the stated distal-end location; a point mass placed elsewhere on link1 would not make its COM coincide with the elbow.

A transpose superscript is printed after a vertically arranged 3x1 n2 vector in an expanded R12 n2 product. Applying it literally makes a3x3 times1x3 product invalid. Use the dimensionally consistent general recursion and the next page’s column-vector expansion, and disclose the printing inconsistency.

reviewChallenge: Independently verify all signed inertia, velocity-product and gravity terms and both recursion directions.
Check point-mass versus joint inertia, gravity-augmented acceleration versus physical acceleration, and the source transpose caveat.
Challenge the remaining angle coverage, concept grouping, difficulty calibration and every numerical distractor.
Numerical inputs are generated source-bound examples, not numbers falsely attributed to the slides.
